title: PayoutState
description: What the payout state service returns for one account on one as_of date. Exactly nine fields.

account_id.description: Stripe account the state is for, e.g. acct_test_maria_bakery.

as_of.description: Only transactions created on or before this date were used.

message.description: Owner message from docs/payout-states.md with placeholders filled. Null only when the reason is unknown.

amount.description: The headline amount as a decimal string: payout amount, pending amount, or available balance (negative when below zero).

currency.description: Lowercase ISO currency code from the transactions.

date.description: Payout arrival date (payout_scheduled) or the date pending money becomes available (pending_only). Null otherwise.

reason.description: Why this state applies: the refund description for negative_after_refund, the no_payout reason (or 'unknown'), null otherwise.

source_transaction_ids.description: balance_transaction_id values the result was worked out from.
